content.comment_body: Hello, I hope someone can assist me. I need a [product_name] with a temperature sensor to control a heating system. I'm unsure which [product_name] model and which temperature sensor to choose. The goal is for the heating to start if the temperature drops below 2°C. Is it possible to record how long the heating is active?

Hello, You can use any [product_name] base module (for example, a [product_name]), along with the [product_name] extension module for temperature measurement. For the sensor, you may consider PT100 or PT1000, since the module supports both. It's also possible to measure the heating system runtime by programming a pulse generator and a counter. Hope this helps.
Hi, You can alternatively use the built-in operating hour counter to log the runtime, if tracking by hours is acceptable for your needs. Hope this is helpful.
Or, you could use an up/down counter block in combination with an asynchronous pulse generator block to measure runtime with finer resolutions, such as minutes or seconds, or other intervals.
